snippet.title: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE - OFFICIAL Halloween TRAILER
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

Find out what really happened in BrokenLore: DON’T WATCH

Don’t trust what you see... 
Don’t trust what you hear... 
Above all, DON’T LIE...
